default.title: Connected CRM actions and organization-based workspaces
default.summary: ClawPilot now connects user profiles, CRM records, provider actions, short links, and managed pipeline workbooks through stable organization and contact identities.
features: Organizations, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Meetings, Interactions, and Campaigns in one pipeline-scoped CRM workspace
Email, calendar invitations, logged calls, and mail-merged campaigns through each user's selected provider connections
Stable ga, gc, gl, go, gm, gi, and gk CRM links plus same-organization short-link discovery
Managed Drive folders nested by organization, user contact, and pipeline with direct Open Sheet access
fixes: Prevents one user from receiving different CRM organization or contact identities across owned pipelines
Synchronizes profile changes into CRM and requeues managed Drive naming without creating replacement Sheets
Pins sign-in and invitation mail to the verified ClawPilot Stewards Gmail connection instead of a personal selected account
Deduplicates repeated CRM markers in email threads and stops imported content at the first %xx marker
Restricts short-link discovery to the user's organization tree and mutations to link owners or authorized administrators
Prevents an outgoing deployment worker from acknowledging Drive hierarchy reconciliation with the legacy folder layout
Backfills each historical pipeline owner's user settings into the matching CRM organization and contact records
Removes empty managed legacy Drive folders only after the organization and contact hierarchy verifies
